name: session-archive
description: Keeps a permanent, readable copy of every Claude Code session: the exact transcript, a Markdown chat, every file version Claude wrote, pasted images, and published artifact links. Runs from hooks, so it costs zero model tokens.

archive_dir.title: Archive folder (where your chats are saved)
archive_dir.description: Folder where every chat is saved. Keep the default ~/claude-archive unless you want it elsewhere, for example ~/Documents/claude-archive. Each chat gets its own subfolder: <folder>/<project>/<date>_<id>/ containing chat.md (readable chat), raw/ (exact copy), and artifacts/ (every file version). Avoid synced or shared folders: chats can contain secrets.

min_sync_minutes.title: Minutes between automatic saves
min_sync_minutes.description: After a reply, save the session at most this often. Session end, compaction, /session-archive:save and file snapshots always save immediately. Use 0 to save after every reply. Keeps cloud-synced archive folders (Google Drive, iCloud) from re-uploading large transcripts every turn.
